fusions.name: Shaken Dry
fusions.desc: A spray around you that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 40% chance to be left [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skidding Touchdown
fusions.desc: Sends a wave along the ground that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets; every other enemy within 3 tiles takes 80% of that. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Runs on the Pond

riders.text: you cross it faster than ground
and blows slide off you while you are on it
and running on it costs you less

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While on it, from bronze rank you move 15% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 8%, and from gold your stamina recovers 20% faster.
